subject: RMR equijoin fails in reduce phase with large datasets

messages.author: 96760a621b5158fc
messages.subject: RMR equijoin fails in reduce phase with large datasets
parts:
I am running a equijoin on a fairly large dataset and the reducer hangs when it's about 75% complete.

Below is the command I am running.



PrepareDataSet <- function(inputPathLeft, inputPathRight, outputPath = NULL) {
    equijoin (
            left.input = inputPathLeft,
            right.input = inputPathRight,

            map.left = function(key, columns) {
                output.key <- paste(key$ClassId,key$StoreId)
                output.value <- columns
                keyval(output.key, output.value)
            },
           map.right = function(key, columns) {
                output.key = paste((key$ClassId,key$StoreId)
                output.value = columns
                keyval(output.key, output.value)
           }  
    )
}

messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1496] RMR equijoin fails in reduce phase with large datasets
parts:
Hi,
It's possible for equijoin to fail because of memory limits, if too many rows are associated with the same key or too many are generated for the same key.  Could you find and share the stderr log of the hanging reduce task? Thanks

Antonio
